keySentence: Fogg made a bold bet to travel the world in 80 days.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: They crossed Europe by train. Everything went according to plan. But the journey was just beginning. Fogg made a bold bet to travel the world in 80 days.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Fogg and Passepartout crossed Europe quickly by train. They passed through Paris, Turin, and Brindisi without any problems. Everything was going exactly according to Fogg's timetable. But they still had to cross oceans and continents ahead. Fogg made a bold bet to travel the world in 80 days. Fogg remained calm, but unexpected challenges were coming soon.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: The first leg of the journey went smoothly as Fogg and Passepartout raced across Europe by rail. They passed through Paris, crossed the Alps to Turin, and reached the Italian port of Brindisi on schedule. Fogg checked his timetable constantly, confirming that they were right on track. Passepartout marveled at the changing scenery while his master remained perfectly composed. Fogg made a bold bet to travel the world in 80 days. However, Europe was the easiest part of their journey around the world. Because the real challenges lay in crossing India, navigating the Pacific, and spanning America, they could not celebrate yet. Fogg knew that maintaining composure would be essential when unexpected problems inevitably arose.
